themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents capable of autonomous action and decision-making within research contexts, including their capabilities, limitations, and applications.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for research and analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing specific AI-powered tools designed to assist researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and understand code, including their security implications and effectiveness.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Explores the impact of AI on recruitment processes, including hiring gains, workload for HR professionals, and the value of AI skills.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI applications for analyzing and understanding customer sentiment from feedback, reviews, and social media.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles discussing the creation and use of simulated users or data for testing AI systems, research, and content generation.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles examining how AI is integrated into the design process and used to support user research activities.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used in the research and development of new products, including market analysis and feature ideation.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Content related to the use of AI in testing the usability of products and systems, and the implications for user experience.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
